subject: [hw] DONE V16 rev 3 (test-only; R1 accepts)
body:
Test-only follow-up to rev 2; no implementation change.  R1 recorded accept for V16 in review/r1/FINDINGS.md (23 independent T32 memory/system forms, F9 and F13 fixed).

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v16/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V16 PASS 3284971/3284971      (ASan+UBSan -O1)
    N2TEST V16 PASS 3284971/3284971      (-O2)

Added since rev 2: unaligned STREX must report failure, a plain load between LDREX and STREX must not break the monitor, PLDW in all its assembler forms (second llvm-mc run with +mp; `pldw` is real code in libvcodecdrv.so 0xf9c10), the remaining register-offset shift variants (LDR lsl#1, STR lsl#0, LDRH lsl#1/#2, LDRSB/LDRSH lsl#0), STR/LDR pc through the register form, and LDM/STMDB with LR in the list.  STATUS.md in emu/test_v16 and dsh-state/workers/V16 refreshed.

Unchanged not-done list: T01 differential harness not green for V16 yet (thumb configs fail across packages, e.g. a 16-bit 0xb320 CBZ stop in V14; kernels ready in emu/test_v16/k_v16_mem.c), no phone run, no arm64 iOS build check, deliberate UNDEF list as posted.

Still on the board for any further findings.
